sonuc.drug_name: DuoPlavin 75 mg/75 mg or 75 mg/100 mg film-coated tablets

what_for.text: It helps prevent blood clots forming in hardened arteries in adults.
what_for.evidence: DuoPlavin is taken by adults to prevent blood clots forming in hardened arteries which can lead to atherothrombotic events (such as stroke, heart attack, or death).

what_for.text: It is used after severe chest pain or a heart attack.
what_for.evidence: You have been prescribed DuoPlavin in place of the two separate medicines, clopidogrel and ASA, to help prevent blood clots because you have experienced a severe type of chest pain known as ‘unstable angina’ or heart attack (myocardial infarction).

how_to_use.text: Take one tablet per day by mouth with a glass of water.
how_to_use.evidence: The recommended dose is one tablet of DuoPlavin per day to be taken orally with a glass of water, with or without food.

how_to_use.text: You can take your tablet with or without food.
how_to_use.evidence: The recommended dose is one tablet of DuoPlavin per day to be taken orally with a glass of water, with or without food.

how_to_use.text: Take your medicine at the same time each day.
how_to_use.evidence: You should take your medicine at the same time each day.

how_to_use.text: If forgotten within 12 hours, take a tablet straightaway.
how_to_use.evidence: If you forget to take a dose of DuoPlavin, but remember within 12 hours of your usual time, take your tablet straightaway and then take your next tablet at the usual time.

how_to_use.text: If forgotten over 12 hours, just take the next dose as usual.
how_to_use.evidence: If you forget for more than 12 hours, simply take the next single dose at the usual time. Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten tablet.

see_doctor_now.text: Contact your doctor straightaway if you are concerned by your bleeding.
see_doctor_now.evidence: However, if you are concerned by your bleeding, you should contact your doctor straightaway (see section 4 ‘Possible side effects’).

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you get yellow skin or eyes.
see_doctor_now.evidence: signs of liver problems such as yellowing of the skin and/or the eyes (jaundice), whether or not associated with bleeding which appears under the skin as red pinpoint dots, and/or confusion (see section 2 ‘Warnings and precautions’).

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you have fever, infection, or extreme tiredness.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Contact your doctor immediately if you experience: ... fever, signs of infection or extreme tiredness.

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you have fever and skin pinpoint dots.
see_doctor_now.evidence: You should also tell your doctor immediately if you develop a medical condition known as Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura or TTP that includes fever and bruising under the skin that may appear as red pinpoint dots

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you get flu-like symptoms and a rash.
see_doctor_now.evidence: You should tell your doctor immediately if you develop symptoms or signs of Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) which may include flu-like symptoms and a rash with fever

side_effects.text: The most common side effect is bleeding.
side_effects.evidence: The most common side effect which has been seen with DuoPlavin is bleeding.

side_effects.text: Common side effects include diarrhoea, abdominal pain, indigestion, or heartburn.
side_effects.evidence: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people): ... Diarrhoea, abdominal pain, indigestion or heartburn.

side_effects.text: Uncommon side effects include headache, stomach ulcer, vomiting, nausea, and dizziness.
side_effects.evidence: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people): ... Headache, stomach ulcer, vomiting, nausea, constipation, excessive gas in stomach or intestines, rashes, itching, dizziness, sensation of tingling and numbness.

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: Do not use after the expiry date on the carton.
storage.evidence: Do not use this medicine after the expiry date which is stated on the carton and on the blister, after EXP.

storage.text: Do not use if you notice visible signs of deterioration.
storage.evidence: Do not use this medicine if you notice any visible sign of deterioration.
